settings.title: Settings
settings.language.desc: Interface language. Auto follows your Windows display language.
settings.theme.desc: Pick a theme or follow Windows.
settings.scanOnStartup.desc: Start scanning as soon as the app opens.
settings.deleteMode.recycle.desc: Safer. Files can be restored, but space is freed only after the bin is emptied.
settings.deleteMode.permanent.desc: Faster and frees space immediately. Cannot be undone.
settings.skipRecent.desc: Temporary files newer than this may still be in use.
settings.customFolders.desc: Add your own cache folders. Their contents are scanned and cleaned like any other target.
settings.customFolders.refused: This folder is protected and cannot be added.
settings.reset.desc: Restore defaults, including target selection and custom folders.
about.description: A fast, beautiful cache and junk cleaner for Windows. It scans well-known temporary, cache and leftover locations across the system, browsers, developer tools, apps and games, then lets you decide what goes.
about.safety.desc: Only files underneath scanned locations are ever touched. Drive roots, Windows, Program Files and your personal folders are hard-blocked. Recycle Bin mode is on by default.

insight.subtitle: Space CacheCleanup will not touch, but you might want to know about.
